title.en: The ten-turn game and the transitions guess
title.nl: The ten-turn game and the transitions guess

summary.fa: دو بازیِ کوچک که می‌شود امتحان کرد: یک بازیِ ده‌نوبتیِ آستانه، و ابزاری که از تو می‌خواهد پانزده گذارِ جهانی را حدس بزنی تا ببینی شهودت با تاریخ کجا جور نیست.
summary.en: Two small games to try: a ten-turn threshold game, and a tool that makes you guess fifteen world transitions to see where your intuition and history part.
summary.nl: Two small games to try: a ten-turn threshold game, and a tool that makes you guess fifteen world transitions to see where your intuition and history part.

text.fa: بازیِ ده‌نوبتی (sim): هر نوبت یک تصمیم دربارهٔ هماهنگی و هزینه؛ هدفش حس‌کردنِ منطقِ آستانه است، نه پیش‌بینی.
text.en: The ten-turn game: each turn a decision about coordination and cost; it is to feel the threshold logic, not to predict.
text.nl: The ten-turn game: each turn a decision about coordination and cost; it is to feel the threshold logic, not to predict.

text.fa: پانزده گذار (transitions): حدس بزن و ببین؛ مناسبِ یک شبِ دورهمی و میزِ دایره‌ای.
text.en: Fifteen transitions: guess and see; suited to an evening gathering and the circle table.
text.nl: Fifteen transitions: guess and see; suited to an evening gathering and the circle table.
